Synopsis:
Dialogue with Halsin in the epilogue of Act 2. In it, he reacts to the various states that could occur in relation to his desire to rid the Act 2 region of the shadow curse:- if you've already done everything needed to ensure success. he's grateful and seeks to remain with you on the journey to Baldur's Gate.- if the curse is not yet sure to be lifted, but there's still something that can be done (ie Thaniel was saved from the Shadowfell, but hasn't been fully restored), he will implore the players to help and offer to join them.- if it's no longer possible to lift the curse, Halsin is sad and resigned to staying behind to stand sentry over it. He will not be available as a companion in Act 3, and his story effectively ends here.

Cluster Contexts:
- SCE_Halsin.json: This scene is the Act 2 epilogue with Halsin, the druid leader who has been fighting a shadow curse that afflicts the region. Thaniel — a spirit of the land — was sundered by the Shadowfell so part of his essence remains corrupted here; whether the curse can be lifted depends on reuniting and restoring him. Halsin’s lines branch based on the player’s progress: if the land is effectively saved he thanks you and asks to continue with you to Baldur’s Gate; if Thaniel is only partially rescued he urges you to finish the task and offers to join; if restoration is no longer possible Halsin resigns himself to staying behind as sentinel and will not be available as a companion in Act 3. The dialogue assumes prior events (the fragmentation of Thaniel and the campaign against the curse/the Absolute) have already occurred.
- CAMP_Halsin2.json: Halsin's default dialogue at camp once he's joined you as a follower. You can ask how he's faring in your company, as well as glean some details about your next quest. Halsin is avuncular and scholarly, but his mood grows darker whenever he speaks of Moonrise Towers and the curse that has shrouded it.Once Thaniel, the spirit of the land, has been rescued and brought to camp, a new branch will unlock where Halsin can explain that Thaniel's heart is missing, and it needs to be retrieved in order for the Shadow curse to be lifted. Halsin can be recruited as a companion 11from then on.
- HAV_HalsinQuest_Spirit.json: The player tries to interact with Thaniel, the spirit of the land, after Halsin rescues him from the Shadowfell. Thaniel is unconscious/unresponsive however.Later - Thaniel is recovering and able to talk. A somewhat otherworldly, wise far beyond his years 'child'. He instructs you on what comes next/offers his thanks once you have succeeded.
- HAV_HalsinQuest_Portal.json: After the player acquires Art's instrument from the Surgeon, and speaks to Art, Halsin is able to use information given by Art to navigate through the Shadowfell, with the intention of recuing Thaniel, the spirit of the land, and ultimately lifting the shadow curse. He asks the player to help him by protecting a portal to the Shadowfell until he can return with Thaniel. He waits by the shore a short distance from Last Light. Once Halsin enters the portal and the dialogue ends, shadow creatures attack. The player must fight off the creatures until Halsin returns. However, if the player attempts to go through the portal themselves, the ritual will fail.
- HAV_HalsinQuest_PortalEntry.json: Halsin has been conducting a ritual to open a portal to the Shadowfell while the player defends him from attacking shadows. In this case, the player interfered with the portal (trying to enter it themselves) causing it to collapse. Halsin reacts, aghast. His one chance to infiltrate the Shadowfell and lift the shadow curse has been lost. He expresses his anger to the player and walks off. Ultimately he will part ways from us for good sometime soon after.

context: Halsin is the druid leader who has spent Act 2 battling the Shadow Curse that chokes the region; the land spirit Thaniel was sundered and part of his essence remained corrupted here. The epilogue branches on what the player has already accomplished: if Thaniel has been fully rescued and restored (for example, his missing heart recovered), the land can be saved and Halsin thanks you and asks to continue to Baldur’s Gate as a companion. If Thaniel is only partially rescued or his missing half is retrievable, Halsin implores you to finish the task and offers to join you in the effort. If restoration is no longer possible (for example a failed ritual/portal or irreversible loss), Halsin sadly resigns himself to stay behind as sentinel and will not be available as a companion in Act 3. The scene presumes the prior campaign against the Absolute and the portal/ritual attempts to reach the Shadowfell.
